jobs.brief: Adult woman about 46, compact strong build, pale freckled skin, square face, bent nose, auburn braid. Ivory-covered brigandine over slate-blue wool, short elbow mail, trousers, kettle helmet, narrow heater shield with a tiny sun, arming sword. Neutral standing pose inspecting a glove. Four isolated equipment studies. Vigil materials referenced without cloning a kit.

jobs.title: Gnosis foot soldier
jobs.notes: Approved high-medieval blue-enamel breastplate, padded clothing and sword. Mirror device removed. Foot soldier recast as a man at the creator's request.
items: Blue-enamel breastplate, front and three-quarter studies
jobs.brief:
An older human woman about 55 with a broad East Asian face, ordinary appealing proportions, short salt-and-pepper hair, slight uneven eyebrows and an experienced attentive expression. Full body, solid grounded stance, looking down as she inspects her shield hinge. Ink-blue padded jack, ONE small smoothly curved blue-enamel breastplate, simple dark trousers and leather ankle boots. A plain thrusting sword sheathed at the hip.
The single experimental object: a forearm mirror buckler with exactly TWO elongated slightly convex polished silver-glass panels in narrow dull bronze frames connected by ONE long hinge. The two panels open into a shallow V, together about the length of her forearm, supported by visible plain rear straps. The device is handmade and convincingly wearable. Pale cyan reflection only, no beam, floating fragments, glowing runes, gears, electronics or gun shapes.
Four separate insets on right: (1) the open two-panel mirror shield, (2) the same shield folded in side/rear profile with hinge and arm straps visible, (3) the simple enamel breastplate, (4) the complete plain thrusting sword. Do not turn it into a multi-panel fan, satellite dish or oversized folding wall.

edit_prompts.purpose: Remove rejected mirror while preserving approved armor and kit
edit_prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit this Breachline character/equipment sheet. The creator approves the character, handsome well-built high-medieval blue-enamel steel breastplate, padded blue clothing, plain thrusting sword and painted style, but explicitly REJECTS the folding mirror device.
Remove EVERY mirror, mirror frame, hinge and mirror strap from the entire image, including from the woman's arm and both top-right insets. Preserve the older woman's exact face, hair, body proportions, clothes, breastplate design, sword design, full-body scale, warm off-white background, painterly realism and neutral lighting. Change only the arms as needed: left arm hangs naturally clear of the torso; right hand calmly rests near the sword belt, anatomically coherent. Show the complete breastplate clearly on the torso.
Rearrange the right half into three useful studies: large front three-quarter view of the SAME blue-enamel breastplate in upper-left of right half; a slightly smaller rear/side view of that SAME breastplate with simple plausible shoulder straps and lining in upper-right; full sword and sheath below with generous negative space. This rear view is a conservative construction study, not a different armor design. Remove the old lower-left duplicate breastplate once it is repositioned. No replacement gadget, no shields or mirror parts, no new weapon, no new accessory. No lettering, numbers, labels, borders or scenery. High-quality 1536x1024 landscape concept painting, broad selective brushwork, no photoreal or 3D gloss.

edit_prompts.purpose: Recast the Gnosis foot soldier as male
edit_prompts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. The creator requests that the blue-armored Gnosis foot soldier in this reference sheet be a MAN.
Change ONLY the full-body character on the left into an adult human male about 50: recognizably masculine ordinary broad face with East Asian features, short salt-and-pepper hair, mild brow asymmetry, a little beard stubble, solid practical soldier's build. Natural, generally appealing but not a glamorous model. Adapt the head, neck, shoulders and hands coherently to the male casting; keep him a human, not an elf or orc.
Preserve the exact approved high-medieval blue-enamel steel breastplate design, its blue color and metallic craftsmanship, quilted blue jacket, brown-black trousers, boots, sword and sheath, shoulder straps and belt. Preserve the relaxed standing pose, full-body scale and framing, left arm down and right hand by the belt. ALL equipment-only studies on the right must remain unchanged. Same warm off-white background, neutral light and economical traditional painted realism, 1536x1024 landscape.
Absolutely no mirror device, no new magic or equipment, no text, labels, scenery or borders. No stylized heroic muscle exaggeration, beauty-filter face, photorealism or 3D rendering.

jobs.title: Porcelain-visored retainer
jobs.notes: One court retainer's commission: pale ceramic faceplate over steel, dark plum tailoring and a narrow thrusting blade. Tests ceremonial menace without defining the entire Dominion wardrobe.
jobs.brief:
An adult human male court retainer about 45, lean long-limbed build, brown skin visible at neck and hands. Still ominous disciplined bearing, three-quarter view facing slightly left; not attacking. Helmet is ordinary forged steel with a detachable pale ivory ceramic faceplate SUPPORTED BY STEEL BACKING. Faceplate has a minimal abstract mask-like human suggestion: two narrow dark eye openings, short bridge and a small breathing slot, one fine glaze crack. NOT a skull, demon, horror monster or decorative human sculpture. No glowing eyes or gold.
A long charcoal and very dark plum wool coat, modest smooth steel half-cuirass visible beneath the opening, small cream cuffs, plain riding boots, one sober clasp. No cape, bone trophies, spikes or repeated belts. Carries a slender estoc point down beside the body, a coherent normal hand at the grip; empty other hand.
Four isolated insets: (1) closed front three-quarter helmet showing ivory mask, (2) same helmet side/rear with removable faceplate opened to reveal its steel backing and practical attachment, (3) wool coat opened enough to show simple half-cuirass, (4) complete estoc and plain sheath. Ceramic is a decorative facing over real steel, not claimed to be an invulnerable mask.

jobs.title: Bronze-harness alderkin
jobs.notes: An alderkin choosing forged protection and a spear for its own purposes. Tests metal equipment fitted to living tree anatomy, with broad padded supports and no nails through bark. No automatic allegiance or duty to humans.
jobs.brief:
Input image 1 is a reference for LIVING TREE anatomy and economical painting only. Invent a new broader, older asymmetrical alderkin with pale grey bark, copper autumn leaves and naturally grown knot eyes. A flexible trunk dividing into root legs, irregular branch arms and a few grasping root fingers, head grown out of trunk. No carved human face, human musculature, human trousers or boots. Preserve true tree-person anatomy while changing the individual from the reference.
This individual has independently chosen fitted forged gear. ONE smooth asymmetrical bronze chest shell is suspended by exactly TWO broad flax loops with clear soft felt padding at contact points. It rests outside bark without piercing it, constricting growth or binding limbs. Simple open-backed bronze forearm guard on one branch arm, other limbs mostly bare. No layers of leaves, belts, leather flaps or decorative metal foliage. Holds a long plain ash spear with modest iron tip, opposite branch hand checks the shell's fit. No humans, gardening, irrigation or landscape.
Four isolated insets: (1) the entire simple bronze chest shell with its two broad harness loops, (2) an empty rear contact view showing soft pads and clearance rather than nails, (3) full spear, (4) open padded forearm guard. Equipment should be made for the actual irregular body shown, not standard human armor strapped to a tree.

jobs.title: Clayplate giant
jobs.notes: The strongest material experiment: three replaceable terracotta plates on heavy padding, with a practical maul. Tests giant-scale local craft. Protection, durability and any cultural tradition remain deliberately unconfirmed.
jobs.brief:
Input image 1 supplies the giants' heavy HUMANOID proportions and broad facial structure only. Invent a NEW mature female giant, barrel-chested and powerfully weight-bearing, warm brown skin, broad face, tightly curled greying hair, ordinary firm appealing features, not a glamorous human model. No ogre tusks, stone skin or caricature. Broad feet and hands appropriate to load-bearing proportions.
Dark charcoal quilted coat over pale rolled-sleeve shirt, plain trousers and practical boots. The single daring experiment is exactly THREE broad curved terracotta protection plates on the torso, two upper chest plates and one abdominal plate. Each hangs securely from modest reinforced edge holes on the padded coat using short simple fasteners. One plate has a muted iron-oxide glaze and a small chip; the others remain intact. Big simple warm red-brown pottery forms, not dozens of tiles, lamellar scales or a leather harness mess. This is an experimental material proposal, not established proven armor. One mismatched plain iron forearm guard. Holds a wooden maul with ONE iron striking cap, sized for an actual wielder rather than a building. Relaxed still pose glancing at a fastening.
Four isolated insets: (1) complete padded garment with precisely the same three clay plates, (2) the back of one separate plate showing its simple padded mounting, (3) entire capped wooden maul, (4) plain iron forearm guard. Do not add extravagant ornaments or oversized skulls.
